actual_plan_A.title: Message-passing GNNs and the 1-WL ceiling
actual_plan_A.label: ML-33
actual_plan_A.description:
Controlling refreshed prose: research/plan-machine-learning-track.md, complete pair section and Current published supplier reconciliation (SHA-256 8cdad5c2b35930196859b2c9a5da7aec4e0cd0f1756eb4ab9b1996ed11b3622b). Read its complete current contract and referenced prerequisite modules; preserved historical wording does not override the dated interface repair. This is prose planning, not proof acceptance.

**Pages:** message-passing-graph-neural-networks / message-passing-graph-neural-networks-examples. **Scope:** Define multiset, message-passing layer aᵥᵏ=AGGREGATEₖ({hᵤᵏ⁻¹:u∈N(v)}), hᵥᵏ=COMBINEₖ(hᵥᵏ⁻¹,aᵥᵏ), permutation-invariant graph readout, one-dimensional WL color refinement, and GIN’s update MLP((1+ε)hᵥ+Σᵤ∈N(v)hᵤ). State both directions: any aggregation-based message-passing GNN cannot distinguish a graph pair that 1-WL cannot; with enough layers and injective multiset aggregation/update and graph readout, it distinguishes each pair that 1-WL distinguishes. For the constructive sum encoder, retain countable feature universe, bounded multiset size, and appropriate irrational scalar ε. Mean and max aggregation can collapse distinct bounded multisets; 1-WL fails on some nonisomorphic regular graphs. The result does not solve graph isomorphism or show every finite practical MLP realizes the ideal injection. Proposed items: def-multiset; def-message-passing-gnn; alg-message-passing-forward-pass; def-one-dimensional-weisfeiler-lehman-test; def-graph-isomorphism-network; thm-message-passing-gnn-no-more-powerful-than-1wl; thm-injective-message-passing-matches-1wl. **Proof route:** induction over WL rounds. For the upper limit, show each GNN update is a function of current WL colors. For the matching construction, injective aggregation/update preserves the exact multiset labels and an injective readout preserves final color multisets; prove the countable bounded-multiset sum encoding. **Examples:** nonisomorphic regular graphs indistinguishable by 1-WL; mean aggregation losing multiplicity; GIN witness on bounded multisets. Empirical graph-classification tables are not theorem evidence. **Requires:** Define finite labeled graphs, graph isomorphism, and the finite-round 1-WL color update locally; no graph-action or CNN theorem is a prerequisite. ML-32 — Convolution and finite-group equivariance is not a mathematical prerequisite. **Sources:** Xu et al., “How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?”, §§2–5, Lemma 2, Theorem 3, Lemma 5, Corollary 6 and Appendices A–I. The stated injective construction is limited to countable features and bounded neighborhood multisets.

items.title: Finite simple undirected graphs with vertex labels
Finite multisets as finitely supported multiplicity functions
Countable bounded multisets admit injective sum encodings
One-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman refinement is invariant under graph isomorphism
Message-passing GNNs cannot distinguish beyond one-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman
Injective message passing matches the one-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman test
